text: Second quarter 2026 operating income decreased $44 million, or 16 percent, primarily due to a lower operating margin rate, partially offset by higher sales. Operating margin rate decreased to 8.6 percent from 10.6 percent, primarily due to lower net EAC adjustments, including a $91 million unfavorable adjustment on GEM 63XL largely related to increases in the projected cost to complete the program, partially offset by favorable changes in contract mix.
reported_basis: unfavorable EAC adjustment, largely projected cost to complete
prohibited_inferences: all margin decline caused by GEM
